To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the KRYPTON system is an essential hybrid reasoning system.

KRYPTON provides a hybrid inference system that is capable of reasoning about both the terminological and assertational knowledge of a domain and that it does so by integrating a frame-based description logic with a first-order theorem prover in an efficient manner.

KRYPTON is a hybrid inference system that combines a description language with a theorem-prover, that it has a Knowledge Level account of its behavior, and that it has a Symbol Level account of its implementation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of hybrid reasoning systems, and we present here the design and implementation of one such system.
the integration of two kinds of knowledge representation formalism and two kinds of reasoning mechanism, with the result of a system that is capable of answering complex questions about the world.
the design of an essential hybrid reasoning system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
KRYPTON is a successful example of a hybrid inference system.
the system is a working, useful, and interesting example of hybrid inference.
KRYPTON is a system that is both powerful enough to be useful and well-enough understood to be interesting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a system that is a good model of the kind of hybrid system that will be needed in the future.
KRYPTON has demonstrated the feasibility of a hybrid system that is a significant step towards the realization of a general intelligent system.
we have shown how to build a practical system that is both knowledge and symbol level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to integrate the two kinds of knowledge representation and reasoning systems that have dominated AI for the past 25 years.
it is possible to have both a knowledge-level and a symbol-level account of a hybrid system.
the hybrid reasoning system is an important and viable approach for the next generation of expert systems.
